justification: The indexing defect is genuine in [Claim 15](https://arxiv.org/html/2306.14317v2). For n=3, k=1 and x=span(e₁) in F₃⁴, ∂₂ cannot act on the 1-chain x, and x⊥ has dimension 3, so d₁ cannot act on it. This verifies the assessment’s objection, which is distinct from the ground-truth false claim about decomposition into hyperbolic pairs.
